mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering recession fears that compress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production signals manufacturing sector weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as growth momentum fades.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive policy, which compresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales indicate strong consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS rises for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll employment decline and unemployment rate increase signal severe labor market contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks rise.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines > 0.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines > 0.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production reading below 110.0 signals manufacturing sector weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as growth momentum deteriorates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 110.0.
